today_in_history_posts.title: Implementing Covenants with OP_CHECKSIGFROMSTACKVERIFY
today_in_history_posts.summary: - OP_CAT and OP_CHECKSIGFROMSTACKVERIFY enable covenant construction in the Elements Alpha sidechain.  - A blog post details script examples for the Moeser-Eyal-Sirer vault using these op codes.  - Russell O'Connor welcomes suggestions for other covenants and is available for implementation questions.

today_in_history_posts.title: Single channel on mobile clients
today_in_history_posts.summary: - Multiple payment channels create complexity for users, including channel management and fee decisions.  - Users typically prefer simplicity and do not want to handle technical channel configurations.  - Developers must balance user experience and functionality when choosing between single or multiple channels.

today_in_history_posts.title: Libbitcoin for Core people
today_in_history_posts.summary: - Libbitcoin achieves up to fifteen times faster IBD performance than Bitcoin Core using advanced concurrency.  - Its relational database structure and event-based asynchronous processing optimize block validation and resource utilization.  - The system supports easy blockchain reorganization, handles unconfirmed transactions, and plans further efficiency improvements.
